title: Parent item groups in coupons and promotions
description: A coupon's get rows and a promotion's exclusion rows that name a parent item group are written out as its child groups, so the parent covers every item under it. The app's service, outside the shop, follows coupon, promotion and item group changes on the event feed. A row a person added is never removed; a row the service added and a person removed is not added back. A promotion's buy or get row naming a parent group is reported, never changed: a child row there would change the offer. After install: make a role with read and write on Coupon and Promotion Bonus Buys Master, and read on Item Group; make the integration user with that role and its API key; choose the user on the feed registration PP PGX Groups. What leaves the shop: the service reads coupons, promotions and item groups, and writes coupon and promotion rows; with these rights its key can change any coupon or promotion.
